gravity.title: Near-zone terrain-corrected Bouguer

Reduction density: 2.67 g/cm³ (user-confirmed). Near-zone radius: 150 m. DEM cell size: 25 m. DEM coverage inside the near-zone window: 100.0%. Vertical datum: orthometric.
